## Task
An anonymous black-box problem with 2 continuous inputs in [0, 1] and 2 competing objectives: `f1` (minimize), `f2` (minimize).

## Inputs
| parameter | type | domain | scale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x_f94` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_eb4` | real | [0, 1] | linear |

## Outputs
- `f1`: objective; minimize (lower is better).
- `f2`: objective; minimize (lower is better).

Goal: find a good set of trade-offs (an approximation of the Pareto front); quality is the hypervolume dominated by the feasible evaluated points relative to the reference point [18, 6] (order: f1, f2).

## Noise
Observations are noiseless: repeated evaluations of the same input return the same value.
